name: MM-IFEval
intro: MM-IFEval 是 MM-IFEngine 论文提出的多模态指令遵循基准，用于评估 C-Level 组合输出约束与 P-Level 图像感知答案。论文基准含 400 道主问题；公开 TSV 另含 287 个移除单项约束的对比辅助请求。本站流程严格区分论文方法、公开文件与当前 VLMEvalKit 的可执行行为。
org: Fudan University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiaotong University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, CPII under InnoHK, Shanghai Innovation Institute
build_method: CC3M/ALLaVA/RICO/MultiUI/ChartQA/Geo170k 图像筛选，16 类任务池或来源 QA 筛选，六大类 32 子类约束整合，人工标注与额外 LLM 冲突复核
metric: C-Level：单题约束得分均值再对 300 题求均值；P-Level：100 题二值准确率；Overall=(300×C+100×P)/400
eval_feature: 规则函数, 含图直接 LLM Judge, 无图对比 Judge, P-Level Gold-list Judge, 正则/布尔/right-wrong 解析
scale: 400 道主问题（300 C-Level + 100 P-Level）；公开 TSV 687 行，另含 287 个对比辅助请求
variant: arXiv v2 · repo bb844a7 · TSV MD5 973bb839961a449565073a5ee70ae7a6 · VLMEvalKit 7055d30
build_method_en: Image filtering over CC3M/ALLaVA/RICO/MultiUI/ChartQA/Geo170k, a 16-task pool or source-QA filtering, six-category/32-subcategory constraint integration, human annotation, and an extra LLM conflict pass
eval_feature_en: Rule functions, image-conditioned direct LLM judge, image-free comparative judge, P-Level gold-list judge, and regex/Boolean/right-wrong parsers
intro_en: MM-IFEval is the multimodal instruction-following benchmark introduced by MM-IFEngine, testing C-Level compositional output constraints and P-Level image-grounded answers. The paper benchmark contains 400 main questions; the public TSV adds 287 auxiliary requests that remove one target constraint. This page keeps the paper method, public artifact, and current VLMEvalKit behavior separate.
scale_en: 400 main questions (300 C-Level + 100 P-Level); the 687-row public TSV adds 287 comparative auxiliary requests
metric_en: C-Level: mean constraint score per item, then mean over 300 items; P-Level: binary accuracy over 100 items; Overall=(300×C+100×P)/400

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit completed 2026-07-21 against arXiv:2504.07957v2, updated 2025-04-27, Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.1-4.2 plus Appendices A, B, and E. The v2 PDF SHA-256 is e927327ac2e67bb0e51de125dd67efc77097d01fead107296f49affcd37d1ec5; the v2 source tar SHA-256 is 966055367b2872be4b41573a19a96b48d8700ecd7070e2f1ab298fbffdf4163e. Official MM-IFEngine repository HEAD is bb844a7f145934da4ed82077735736d02bfafca4 dated 2026-02-13. Its Apache-2.0 LICENSE SHA-256 is c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4. The bundled scoring script last changed at d4900dd5d39a162ad77477959777a9e4e9e0163d and has SHA-256 93dd639d1070dfbb5c2daa0607121963c7299e1c1d09e37f5182054d5140fe01; bundled inference SHA-256 is aa1fc000054814991b2940f3ccffb38dedfc1941603a3933e1e6157a106dae9b. Construction boundary: MM-IFEngine filters low-resolution or semantically poor images, using IC9600 and RAM as richness signals, across CC3M and ALLaVA natural scenes, RICO mobile UI, MultiUI web UI, ChartQA chart/diagram images, and Geo170k math/geometry images. For sources without QA, the main text defines a 16-task pool, samples k examples, asks GPT-4o to select or supplement image-aligned tasks, and samples for diversity. For ALLaVA QA, regex and length limits remove questions with few-shot examples or options. The six-category, 32-subcategory pool covers text length, mathematics, language/formatting, rhetoric/logic, action, and keywords. An LLM generates concrete content; the QA branch decouples selection and generation, reselects mostly compatible types, and a separate LLM validation rejects constraints that contradict or do not fit the task. Human annotation is critical for benchmark problems, followed by an extra LLM conflict-mitigation pass. The paper does not disclose image-QC thresholds, per-source benchmark counts, accept/reject counts, annotator number/qualification/agreement, exact benchmark-generation or conflict-check prompts, model snapshots, seeds, or deduplication, leakage, and contamination tests. Release boundary: the paper benchmark has 400 main questions, comprising 300 C-Level open-ended items with mean 5.1 constraints and 100 P-Level items with ground-truth lists across 13 image classes. The main text says 16 task descriptions, while v2 Appendix A.1.2 and Table 6 list 18 instructions; this internal drift is preserved rather than silently normalized. The audited public MM-IFEval.tsv is 74,871,020 bytes, MD5 973bb839961a449565073a5ee70ae7a6, and SHA-256 1c6fc51006ef3e30e4b3af85884257d4346d5fc07fe7a8c9773ff68a1470dd54. It contains 687 rows: 400 main rows and 287 aux_cmp_gpt rows. Main rows are exactly 300 C-Level plus 100 P-Level. The 300 C items contain 1,524 constraints, with 489 rule_based, 748 direct_gpt, and 287 cmp_gpt assignments; each cmp_gpt constraint has one auxiliary request with that constraint removed. The TSV has no source, origin, license, or image-rights field. Its server reported Last-Modified Wed, 23 Apr 2025 06:26:04 GMT and ETag BFAC9FC0415EF274A7179944AC301D82-8, but the TLS certificate expired 2026-04-16; on the audit date it downloaded only with certificate verification disabled. Therefore openness is categorized as partly public: code is Apache-2.0 and the TSV is publicly downloadable, but no benchmark-specific data license, row-level source provenance, or upstream image-rights mapping was found. ChrisDing1105/MMIF-23k at revision d7997b72999195680664e850d75d3fe3e96eaf49 is public Apache-2.0 training data, not the MM-IFEval benchmark artifact. Evaluation boundary: candidate C requests use image plus instruction and all constraint values; P requests use image plus raw question; 287 auxiliary requests regenerate an answer after removing one comparative constraint. Ten constraint subcategories use functions selected with extracted parameters and manually reviewed mappings. Current VLMEvalKit casts candidate predictions to string before rule functions. The direct judge sees the image, candidate answer, and direct constraints, requests Score of constraint_i: x/y, strips whitespace and asterisks, and parses numerator divided by denominator. The comparative judge receives the target constraint and with/without-constraint answers without an image, then parses the first True or False after the last Summary. The P judge receives the question, candidate answer, and JSON ground-truth list without an image, requires every element to appear with substring matching allowed, and parses exact right/wrong before searching right ahead of wrong. Failure behavior is route-specific in current VLMEvalKit. Direct-judge and P-Level parse failures retry the outer item loop up to three times. A cmp_gpt parse failure increments num_retry but continues only the inner constraint loop; the failed constraint is omitted, the item still returns success, and its denominator shrinks to successfully recorded constraints. Rule-function exceptions propagate without a fallback. The image helper retries an API call four times and the text-only helper three times, but both can return an uninitialized ans after total API exhaustion and abort evaluation. Current C aggregation uses missing total_score as 0 after semantic fix a039b677c682adfdd1b66170390b3e092efaece9, while an exhausted P parse failure has no total_score fallback and can stop aggregation. Under successful scoring each C item is the mean of its recorded constraint scores; C-Level is the mean over 300 items; P-Level is the mean of 100 binary scores; Overall=(300*C+100*P)/400. Current VLMEvalKit writes 0-to-1 ratios, while paper tables print percentages. Evaluator version boundary: the paper does not pin a judge snapshot. Bundled repository scoring uses gpt-4o-2024-11-20 for C and gpt-4o-mini for P with temperature 0, max_tokens 4096, high image detail, and 300-second timeout. The README says VLMEvalKit's default is gpt-4o-2024-05-13, whereas current VLMEvalKit HEAD 7055d3010c38ccb5dcae1bc9535ca19c7fe5d79f uses the mutable gpt-4o alias by default and permits a custom judge; these paths are not claimed to reproduce one identical paper run. The project page SHA-256 is 3b22c7ab3306a5d1b00a70ca7c4333f29d59c78915855f40becad4b9625053c8 and still reports training gains that differ from arXiv v2, while its Code and Dataset buttons are mutable links rather than immutable releases. The bilingual specs have identical 20-node, 20-edge topology, node types, positions, and connector types, and use the academic-paper profile with the academic-color theme, orthogonal routing, and an explicit numeric 10-point node font. Temporary strict generation and XML validation passed for both languages with only 20 long-label info notices and no warning/error-level finding. Draw.io Desktop exports measured 1345x1525 in both English and Chinese. Both original-size PNGs were visually reviewed after removing duplicate edge labels and module-title overlap; no clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, or unreadable text remained. Formal drawio, arch, SVG, and PNG assets were intentionally not overwritten in this source-only task. Formal publication evidence [site-a11l-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1325×1505 (English) and 1325×1505 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1323×1503 and 1323×1503. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
